Whalerock Point Partners Has Trimmed Its At&T (T) Position by $810,540; Stock Declined; Brandes Investment Partners LP Has Cut Posco (PKX) Position by $1.26 Million as Stock Value Declined
May 14, 2018 - By Adrian Mccoy
Brandes Investment Partners Lp decreased its stake in Posco (PKX) by 3.56% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Brandes Investment Partners Lp sold 16,137 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.98% with the market. The institutional investor held 437,255 shares of the steel and iron ore company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $34.16M, down from 453,392 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Brandes Investment Partners Lp who had been investing in Posco for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $27.35B market cap company. The stock increased 3.12% or $2.6 during the last trading session, reaching $86.22. About 63,435 shares traded. POSCO (NYSE:PKX) has risen 26.98% since May 14, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 15.43% the S&P500.
Whalerock Point Partners Llc decreased its stake in At&T Inc (T) by 35.92% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Whalerock Point Partners Llc sold 21,330 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.37% with the market. The institutional investor held 38,059 shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.48 million, down from 59,389 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Whalerock Point Partners Llc who had been investing in At&T Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $198.48B market cap company. The stock increased 0.09% or $0.03 during the last trading session, reaching $32.32. About 16.21 million shares traded. AT&T Inc. (NYSE:T) has declined 15.88% since May 14, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 27.43% the S&P500.
Among 7 analysts covering POSCO ( NYSE:PKX ), 4 have Buy rating, 2 Sell and 1 Hold. Therefore 57% are positive. POSCO had 9 analyst reports since August 31, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The rating was upgraded by JP Morgan on Tuesday, April 5 to “Overweight”. The rating was upgraded by Macquarie Research on Thursday, July 21 to “Outperform”. The company was downgraded on Friday, April 15 by HSBC. The firm earned “Sell” rating on Monday, May 9 by CLSA. The rating was downgraded by Zacks to “Hold” on Monday, August 31. Macquarie Research downgraded the shares of PKX in report on Thursday, September 3 to “Neutral” rating. The stock has “Buy” rating by Goldman Sachs on Tuesday, January 2. The stock of POSCO (NYSE:PKX) has “Hold” rating given on Monday, August 7 by Standpoint Research. The stock of POSCO (NYSE:PKX) earned “Buy” rating by Nomura on Thursday, January 26.
Another recent and important POSCO (NYSE:PKX) news was published by Seekingalpha.com which published an article titled: “POSCO says CEO Kwon to step down early” on April 18, 2018.
Brandes Investment Partners Lp, which manages about $26.91B and $4.95B US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Infosys Ltd (NYSE:INFY) by 790,457 shares to 1.32M shares, valued at $21.33M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Avnet Inc (NYSE:AVT) by 58,010 shares in the quarter, for a total of 458,139 shares, and has risen its stake in Css Inds Inc (NYSE:CSS).
Among 33 analysts covering AT&T Inc. ( NYSE:T ), 13 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 19 Hold. Therefore 39% are positive. AT&T Inc. had 83 analyst reports since July 27, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. On Wednesday, October 11 the stock rating was maintained by KeyBanc Capital Markets with “Hold”. The company was maintained on Tuesday, July 18 by Cowen & Co. As per Friday, July 15, the company rating was maintained by Barclays Capital. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Thursday, February 4 by DA Davidson. The firm has “Neutral” rating given on Thursday, April 26 by UBS. KeyBanc Capital Markets maintained the shares of T in report on Tuesday, January 2 with “Sector Weight” rating. Deutsche Bank maintained the shares of T in report on Monday, November 14 with “Buy” rating. Morgan Stanley maintained the shares of T in report on Wednesday, September 27 with “Equal-Weight” rating. Macquarie Research initiated the shares of T in report on Tuesday, April 5 with “Outperform” rating. The stock of AT&T Inc. (NYSE:T) earned “Outperform” rating by Cowen & Co on Wednesday, April 27.
Whalerock Point Partners Llc, which manages about $651.31 million and $315.86 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Intel Corp (NASDAQ:INTC) by 9,250 shares to 37,490 shares, valued at $1.73 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Danaher Corp (NYSE:DHR) by 5,197 shares in the quarter, for a total of 11,734 shares, and has risen its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
